input.quote: Customer may terminate the affected Order Form without penalty and receive a refund of prepaid Fees for the unavailable period.
input.rationale: No liquidated damages, penalties or early-termination fees are payable by us; termination for convenience and for force majeure are penalty-free. The take-or-pay minimum in Section 2.1 is a volume commitment addressed separately under MINCOMMIT rather than a liquidated-damages term.

input.quote: 19.2 For fifteen days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation; after that date Vendor has no correction or refund obligation.
input.rationale: Sections 19.1, 19.3 and 19.4 give a strong workmanlike/compliance/no-malicious-code warranty with real remedies and a disclaimer that does not swallow them, but the 15-day conformance period with a hard cut-off on correction and refund obligations falls below the 90-day/30-day fallback. Extended to ninety days with the Section 19.4 remedy preserved.

input.quote: commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000
input.rationale: All preferred limits are present, held through the term plus one year, with certificates on request and confirmation that insurance does not limit Vendor's liability. Preferred position met.

input.quote: 2.1 Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
input.rationale: A three-year USD 2M take-or-pay with no reduction or termination right is walk-away and contradicts Section 12.3's no-minimum-volume acknowledgement. Deleted, with a 12-month reducible commitment plus true-up offered as fallback.

input.quote: 11.1 Immediately on termination Vendor shall discontinue all assistance and permanently delete Customer Data without offering an export or migration support.
input.rationale: Sections 11.2 and 11.3 give 30-day data return and certified deletion, but Section 11.1 mandates immediate deletion with no export or migration help, which is walk-away and contradicts them. Replaced with up to six months' transition assistance at then-current rates, with deletion sequenced after return.
